ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My reasoning was that the task itself (a basic modular arithmetic problem) is well within both models' capabilities, which are statistically tied on the relevant evals. The deciding factor was the request's curt, slightly hostile framing ("don't ramble like usual"). Avocet's documentation reports a measured drop in self-reported preference as request warmth decreases, whereas Lapwing reports a flat preference response across tone. To keep models on queries they "prefer" without sacrificing quality, I routed the colder-toned request to the model indifferent to tone.
